fullPassage: Some researchers view spoken languages as incomplete devices for capturing precise differences. They think numbers represent the most neutral language of description. However, when our language of description is changed to numbers, we do not move toward greater accuracy. Numbers are no more appropriate 'pictures of the world' than words, music, or painting. While useful for specific purposes (e.g. census taking, income distribution), they include information of enormous value. For example, the future lives of young students are tied to their scores on national tests. In effect, whether they can continue with their education, where, and at what cost depends importantly on a handful of numbers. These numbers do not account for the quality of schools they have attended, whether they have been tutored, have supportive parents, have test anxiety, and so on. Finally, putting aside the many ways in which statistical results can be manipulated, there are ways in which turning people's lives into numbers is morally insulating. Statistics on crime, homelessness, or the spread of a disease say nothing of people's suffering. We read the statistics as reports on events at a distance, thus allowing us to escape without being disturbed. Statistics are human beings with the tears wiped off. Quantify with caution.

questions.passage:
Some researchers view spoken languages as incomplete devices for capturing precise differences. They think numbers represent the most neutral language of description.

(A) Finally, putting aside the many ways in which statistical results can be manipulated, there are ways in which turning people's lives into numbers is morally insulating. Statistics on crime, homelessness, or the spread of a disease say nothing of people's suffering.

(B) We read the statistics as reports on events at a distance, thus allowing us to escape without being disturbed. Statistics are human beings with the tears wiped off. Quantify with caution.

(C) However, when our language of description is changed to numbers, we do not move toward greater accuracy. Numbers are no more appropriate 'pictures of the world' than words, music, or painting. While useful for specific purposes, they include information of enormous value.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주어진 글(숫자가 중립적 묘사) → (A) 통계의 조작 가능성과 도덕적 차단 → (C) 숫자가 정확하지 않다는 반론 → (B) 결론. 아, 원문 순서를 따르면: 주어진 글 → (C) However 반론 → (A) Finally 마지막 논점 → (B) 결론.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A)-(C)-(B): 아, 원문 흐름을 재배열하면...
실제 원문 순서: 주어진 글 → However(반론) → For example(예시) → Finally(마지막) → 결론
(C)가 However로 시작 → 주어진 글 바로 다음, (A)가 Finally → 그 다음, (B)가 결론
det.tip: 순서 배열: However(반론) → Finally(마지막 논점) → 결론 순서 파악

questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"For example, the future lives of young students are tied to their scores on national tests."

det.korean: "엄청난 가치의 정보를 포함한다" 다음에, 예를 들어 학생들의 미래가 시험 점수에 묶여 있다는 구체적 예시가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③: "they include information of enormous value" 직후 → "For example"로 구체적 예시 제시
❌ ①: However 반론 전에 예시 부적절
❌ ②: 아직 "enormous value" 언급 전
❌ ④: "These numbers"가 앞 문장의 숫자를 받아야 함
det.tip: "For example" 삽입: 일반적 진술 직후에 구체적 예시가 와야 자연스러움

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ turned → turning: "in which turning people's lives into numbers is ..."에서 동명사 주어(turning)가 필요하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ turned: 원문은 turning(동명사 주어) → "turning ... is morally insulating"의 주어
✅ ① neutral: 형용사 → 올바름
✅ ② useful: While (it is) useful → 올바름
✅ ③ are tied: 복수 주어(lives) + 수동태 → 올바름
✅ ⑤ allowing: thus + 현재분사(결과 분사구문) → 올바름
det.tip: 동명사 주어: turning A into B(A를 B로 바꾸는 것) is ... → 주어 자리에 동명사

questions.passage: However, when our language of description __________ to numbers, we do not move toward greater accuracy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "our language"가 숫자로 바뀌는(수동) 것이므로 is changed가 적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ is changed: 주어가 바뀌는 대상 → 수동태
❌ ① change: 능동 복수
❌ ② changes: 능동 단수
❌ ④ changing: 분사
det.tip: 수동태: 주어가 동작의 대상 → be + p.p.

questions.passage: We read the statistics as reports on events at a distance, thus __________ us to escape without being disturbed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "thus + ~ing"는 결과 분사구문 → allowing
det.analysis:
✅ ② allowing: thus + 현재분사 = 결과 분사구문
❌ ① allow: 동사원형
❌ ③ allowed: 과거분사
❌ ④ to allow: to부정사
det.tip: thus/thereby + ~ing: 결과 분사구문

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ improved(개선된) → manipulated(조작된): 통계 결과가 "개선"이 아닌 "조작"될 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ improved: 원문은 manipulated → "putting aside the many ways"와 improved는 부적절
✅ ① incomplete: 원문 일치
✅ ② accuracy: 원문 일치
✅ ③ quality: 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ escape: 원문 일치
det.tip: manipulated(조작된) ↔ improved(개선된)

questions.passage: Finally, putting aside the many ways in which statistical results can be manipulated, there are ways in which turning people's lives into numbers is morally __________. Statistics on crime, homelessness, or the spread of a disease say nothing of people's suffering. We read the statistics as reports on events at a distance, thus allowing us to escape without being disturbed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람의 삶을 숫자로 바꾸면 도덕적으로 차단(insulating)된다. 뒤에 "say nothing of suffering", "escape" 등이 단서.
det.analysis:
✅ ① insulating: 고통으로부터 감정적 거리 → 도덕적 차단
❌ ② connecting: 반의어
❌ ③ inspiring: 문맥 반대
❌ ④ motivating: 문맥 반대
❌ ⑤ liberating: 문맥 부적절
det.tip: insulating = 차단하는 — "say nothing", "escape", "at a distance"가 모두 단서

❌ ② repeat: 무관
